timelines.title: Bigg Boss Tamil Awards Season 10
timelines.message: Day 40. Bigg Boss holds the Season 10 Awards ceremony where housemates present 18 awards to each other. Highlights: Shathiga receives Neelambari Award (from Shama), Dhanya receives Kattapa Award (from Asmitha) & Nee Pudungura Aani Award (from Chandini), TTF Vasan receives Opening Ok Finishing Sari Illa Pa Award (from Muniyammal) & Nee Ethukkume Sari Pattu Vara Maata Award (from Lakshmi Priya), Jason receives Singam Award (from Ansar) & Aathira Karanuku Budhi Mattu Award (from Muthazhagi), Karishma receives Pachondhi Award (from TTF Vasan) & Kaipulla Award (from Avinash), Muthazhagi receives Mayil Award (from Akshitha) & Nari Award (from Jason), Shama receives Paambu Award (from Shathiga), Avinash receives Headmaster Award (from Karishma), Muniyammal receives Vaai Illana Naai Thookitu Poidum Award (from Vinoth), Chandini receives Most Stylish Award (from Raghav) & Expensive Tourist Award (from Mukesh), Lakshmi Priya receives Cringe Comedy Award (from Dhanya), and Mukesh receives Best Cook Award (from Prithivi). A total of 18 awards were presented to 12 unique recipients, while 6 housemates (Akshitha, Asmitha, Prithivi, Raghav, Vinoth Babu, Ansar) received no awards.

timelines.title: Investigation Panel Misses the Diamond
timelines.message: Day 39. The house picks Avinash, Vinoth and Jason to question three suspects: TTF Vasan, Dhanya and Karishma. They do not find the diamond.

timelines.title: TTF Vasan Hides the Diamond
timelines.message: Day 38. TTF Vasan takes the diamond in front of Avinash and hides it in the bathroom ventilator. Avinash sends Ashmitha after him. She cannot find the spot.

timelines.title: Diamond Heist and Dance Marathon Begin
timelines.message: Day 37. Bigg Boss starts The Greatest Diamond Heist. All 18 housemates play as thieves. Hide a stolen diamond until the weekend and you are the best thief. Get caught and you are out of the task, with a punishment. TTF Vasan hides the diamond. No one else has taken it yet. Dance Marathon 10.0 runs at the same time. Pairs are Jason and Chandini, Prithivi and Shama, Akshitha and Mukesh, TTF Vasan and Muniyammal, Shathiga and Muthazhagi, Karishma and Ansar, Lakshmi Priya and Vinoth, Dhanya and Avinash, and Ashmitha and Raaghav. They dance whenever their song plays.

timelines.title: Vinoth Calls Muthazhagi a Dummy Leader
timelines.message: Shama and Shathiga, on the opposition side, slow the ruling team’s work. Ansar tries to stay calm. Vinoth tells Muniyammal that opposition leader Muthazhagi is a dummy leader. TTF Vasan backs him and the remark turns into a fight.

timelines.title: Ansar Becomes Week 6 Captain
timelines.message: Leadership task. Housemates roll the dice and give the points to Muthazhagi, Muniyammal or Ansar. Ansar 79, Muthazhagi 30, Muniyammal 10. Ansar is captain. Opposition under Muthazhagi: TTF Vasan, Muniyammal, Chandini, Shathiga, Shama and Akshitha. The rest stay with Ansar. Raaghav heads cooking. Ashmitha heads cleaning. Ansar, Muthazhagi and Muniyammal are safe from this nomination. Shathiga calls Ansar for an inspection and he refuses. The opposition fights him over it.

timelines.title: Eight Named in Open Nominations
timelines.message: First open nomination of the season. Vinoth nominates Jason for using aggression and emotion. Jason nominates Vinoth for the same reason. Chandini nominates Avinash over how he played Magic Potion. Dhanya nominates TTF Vasan for needing every instruction repeated. Nominated: Akshitha, Avinash, Chandini, Karishma, Mukesh, Shama, Shathiga and TTF Vasan.

timelines.title: Vijay Sethupathi Questions Akshitha’s Captaincy
timelines.message: Weekend episode. Vijay Sethupathi asks how Akshitha’s week as captain went. Ansar, Avinash, Muniyammal, Mukesh and Dhanya say she was too soft and that advisor Jason was really leading. TTF Vasan defends her first week. He plays the week-1 clip of Shama and Lakshmi Priya agreeing she would cook only if Shama did not nominate her, and he treats it as a game move. He then says there is no eviction this week.

timelines.title: Jason Gets the Second Eviction-Free Pass
timelines.message: Vijay Sethupathi asks the house who should get the second eviction-free pass. Most of them pick Jason. He can use it once, and it lasts until week 10. He thanks the house. Vijay TV posts him as the winner. No one leaves this weekend.

timelines.title: Letters After Magic Potion
timelines.message: Day 33. After Magic Potion ends, Bigg Boss asks each housemate to write to the person they like most. The pairs who fought through the task read the letters and several of them cry. Ansar breaks down reading Muniyammal’s letter, which calls him her little brother. Avinash apologises to Jason.

timelines.title: Muniyammal and Muthazhagi Win Magic Potion
timelines.message: Muniyammal and Muthazhagi win Magic Potion. TV9: they are in line for an eviction-free pass at the weekend and for the next captaincy race, with Ansar also in that race. Shama names TTF Vasan the worst performer and says he wastes time understanding the task. Vasan argues back. The pass has not been handed over yet.

timelines.title: LakshmiPriya & Raagav Out of Magic Potion (8th Exit)
timelines.message: Muniyammal, Muthazhagi filled last life line of LakshmiPriya & Raagav

timelines.title: Anser & Sathiga uses gold power to took 1 life of Muniyammal & Muthazhagi
timelines.message: Anser & Sathiga uses gold power to took 1 life of Muniyammal & Muthazhagi and give 1 life to LakshmiPriya & Raagav

timelines.title: Anser & Shathiga Out of Magic Potion (7th Exit)
timelines.message: Muniyammal, Muthazhagi filled last life line of Anser & Sathiga

timelines.title: Ashmitha & Prithivi Out of Magic Potion (6th Exit)
timelines.message: Ansar & Shathiga, Raagav & Lakshmipriya filled last life line of Ashmitha & Prithivi

timelines.title: Vinoth & Shama Out of Magic Potion (5th Exit)
timelines.message: Ansar & Shathiga filled last life line of Vinoth & Shama

timelines.title: Avinash & Akshitha Out of Magic Potion (4th Exit)
timelines.message: Ansar & Shathiga, Prithivi & Ashmitha filled last life line of Avinash & Akshitha

timelines.title: Avinash’s Golden Brick Brings Vinoth and Shama Back
timelines.message: Day 32 of Magic Potion. The Golden Brick can take one life from a pair and give it to another, including a pair already out of the task. Avinash finds it, takes a life from Prithivi and Ashmitha, and gives it to Vinoth and Shama. That pair is back in the task. Muthazhagi and Shathiga clash over the pause rule.

timelines.title: Jason and Mukesh Out of Magic Potion (3rd Exit)
timelines.message: Lakshmipriya & Vintoh filled last life line of Jason & Mukesh

timelines.title: Vasan and Chandini Out of Magic Potion (2nd Exit)
timelines.message: Magic Potion task, not a house eviction. TTF Vasan and Chandini are the second pair knocked out after all 10 life bottles are filled. Round 2 adds a B6 weapon: six blue bricks can pause another team. Prithvi and Asmitha say they will use it on Avinash and Akshitha.

timelines.title: Dhanya and Karishma Out of Magic Potion (1st Exit)
timelines.message: Dhanya and Karishma are the first pair out of the Magic Potion task after their 10 life bottles are filled. They are still in the house. During the task Asmitha tells Dhanya she will finish her and send her out.

timelines.title: Jason and Avinash Clash
timelines.message: Magic Potion day. Jason and Avinash fight during the task and the house splits on where gameplay ends. Muniyammal plays it with Muthazhagi and tells Bigg Boss that six of their bottles are still alive.

timelines.title: Magic Potion Task Starts
timelines.message: Pairs collect blue, green and red bricks to fill rival life bottles. A pair drops out of the task when all 10 bottles are filled. The first pair out faces a heavy punishment. Jason and Mukesh hold their station the longest until Ansar fills one bottle. TTF Vasan’s remarks about captain Akshitha anger Jason. Opposition leader Muniyammal backs Vasan.

timelines.title: Vasan and Jason Fight Over Slippers
timelines.message: Jason tells Dhanya that slippers left in one area will be thrown out. TTF Vasan objects. The argument turns aggressive and the house pulls them apart.

timelines.title: Week 5 Nominations
timelines.message: New wildcards TTF Vasan and Karishma cannot be nominated. Captain Akshitha is also safe. Nominated: Avinash, Chandini, Dhanya, Jason, Lakshmi Priya, Muthazhagi, Raaghav and Shama.

timelines.title: Akshitha Wins Captaincy
timelines.message: Week 5 captaincy is only among the new wildcards. Housemates drop balls for their pick: Akshitha 271, Karishma 40, TTF Vasan 16. Akshitha becomes captain. Opposition, led by Muniyammal: Ansar, Mukesh, Shathiga, Dhanya, TTF Vasan and Karishma. Lakshmi Priya heads the kitchen with Asmitha and Chandini. Jason is Akshitha’s advisor. The ruling side’s rule that they eat first is rejected by the opposition.

timelines.title: TTF Vasan, Karishma and Akshitha Enter
timelines.message: Vijay TV wildcard night. YouTuber TTF Vasan, commoner Karishma and TV actor Akshitha Ashok enter. In the entry task Vasan says Jason is playing the game wrong, and Karishma calls him an empty bin who targets a different girl every week. Dhanya and Shama clap. Akshitha, Avinash’s sister, hugs him and tells him that talking will not win.

timelines.title: Javeed and Savinya Evicted Again
timelines.message: Rope twist ends. Savinya is voted out for the second time. Javeed is out again after the rope disconnects near the pool, a task rule break. Kumaran had already taken the ₹5 lakh and left. Lakshmi Priya, Dhanya and Asmitha stay from the rope group.

timelines.title: Hotel Task 2.0 and Food Row
timelines.message: Day 25. Roles flip: the five rope-task housemates (Lakshmi Priya, Savinya, Asmitha, Javeed, Dhanya) become hotel staff for the other 12. Dhanya and Javeed cook. Jason clashes with manager Lakshmi Priya over late food. Vijay TV: do not create problems over food. Two evictions are teased; names are not out.

timelines.title: Three Wildcards on 4 October
timelines.message: Vijay TV locks three new wildcard entries for Sunday 4 October, 8 PM. Faces are not revealed. Kumaran’s exit interview airs the same day.

timelines.title: Kumaran Walks With ₹5 Lakh
timelines.message: Day 24 hotel task. Vinoth and Avinash get red-dot punishments and are sent to the garden. Bigg Boss offers the rope-task contestants a ₹5 lakh cash box to leave. Kumaran Thangarajan takes it to be with his unwell father. Vijay TV later posts his exit interview. Lakshmi Priya is left without her rope partner.

timelines.title: Savinya–Asmitha Physical Confrontation
timelines.message: Day 23 promos: Lakshmi questions Kumaran's game. Savinya and Asmitha fight; Savinya pushes Asmitha. Six-person rope eviction is still unresolved. Season ongoing; no finale yet.

timelines.title: Hotel Task Starts (Monday)
timelines.message: Monday Day 22: Bigg Boss house becomes a hotel. Non-rope housemates work as staff. The six rope-bound contestants (Lakshmi–Kumaran, Javeed–Dhanya, Savinya–Asmitha) are treated as luxury guests. Staff must serve them. Task runs alongside the rope eviction twist.

timelines.title: Rope Task Dynamics & House Clashes
timelines.message: Dhanyaa breaks down while tied to Javeed after teasing from Muniyammal, Ansar and Jason. Muniyammal vs Avinash clashes continue, and Savinya and Muniyammal target Asmitha amidst ongoing rope eviction dynamics.

timelines.title: The Turning Point Rope Task
timelines.message: Six people enter the danger zone. Bigg Boss says only three of the six will stay. Scissors are placed; anyone can cut the rope and walk out. Open nominations are announced then cancelled; Week 4 has no captain and no Democracy Room.

timelines.title: 3 Contestant Reentry
timelines.message: Evicted housemates Lakshmi Priya, Javeed Sherif and Savinya Velu re-enter. They must each tie a rope to a housemate they think is unfit: Savinya–Asmitha, Lakshmi–Kumaran, Javeed–Dhanyaa.

timelines.title: 3 Eviction-Free Passes
timelines.message: Bigg Boss reveals three one-time eviction-free passes valid until Week 10, raising late-game strategy stakes.

timelines.title: Anandhi Exits After Family Tragedy
timelines.message: Anandhi leaves around Day 20. She was already facing public votes; her father dies of a heart attack and she is sent out urgently. Reports mix public-vote eviction with compassionate/emergency exit.

timelines.title: Lakshmi Priya Evicted
timelines.message: Housemate vote: Lakshmi Priya 7, Anandhi 4, Muthazhagi 3. Lakshmi is 4th out. She criticizes Avinash as a weak captain before leaving.

timelines.title: Spotlight Task
timelines.message: Acting/performance Spotlight task. Worst performers named: Lakshmi Priya, Muthazhagi, Anandhi. They must pitch to stay; housemates vote.

timelines.title: Titles Task and Anandhi Breakdown
timelines.message: Housemates impersonate each other, then assign sarcastic titles (Anandhi tagged Drama Queen). Anandhi is heavily nominated, asks Bigg Boss to open the door, and considers walking.

timelines.title: Kitchen Row and Week 3 Nominations
timelines.message: Ruling vs opposition fight over cleaning and food. Shathiga–Ansar kitchen spat. Nominations include Anandhi, Ansar, Chandini, Dhanyaa, Lakshmi Priya, Muniyammal, Shama; Raaghav gets a direct nomination via star ratings.

timelines.title: Avinash Wins Captaincy
timelines.message: Find the Dinosaur Egg task: Avinash beats Vinoth and Mukesh after housemate voting and team support (Prithivi finds the key). Avinash takes oath in Democracy Room.

timelines.title: Manivannan Public Eviction
timelines.message: Manivannan is evicted after public votes (3rd eviction). Short wildcard stay. Ansar is emotional. Host reviews Cheese House clashes with Shama, Jason, Anandhi and Lakshmi Priya.

timelines.title: VijaySethupati provides a clarifications
timelines.message: VJS provides the clarifications on whatever he critized last week is only belongs to this show

timelines.title: Javeed Evicted by Housemates
timelines.message: Javeed is voted out by housemates (2nd eviction). Commoner vs celebrity tension and nomination strategy become central dynamics.

timelines.title: Week 2 Captain Mukesh / Shama
timelines.message: Mukesh and later Shama hold leadership. Mukesh uses an eviction-free pass advantage. Leader Exit List targets include Shama, Asmitha and Javeed.

timelines.title: Cheese House Task
timelines.message: Musical-chairs style Cheese House in the garden: 19 people, shrinking holes. Physical scramble, arguments, and later host grilling over roughness.

timelines.title: Physical Clash During Task
timelines.message: Lakshmi Priya–Anandhi fight escalates during a task; Anandhi is pushed and appears injured. Host later questions both sides.

timelines.title: Anandhi Wildcard Entry
timelines.message: Actress Anandhi Ajay enters on Day 8/9 as second wildcard. She is emotional on arrival and quickly clashes with Lakshmi Priya and others.

timelines.title: VijaySethupati criticizes TVK Vijay indirectly
timelines.message: VJS criticized TVK Vijay indirectly by giving false promise and blamming opponent when comes to power

timelines.title: First Eviction: Savinya
timelines.message: Leader Exit List after Night Stars: Muniyammal, Dhanyaa, Savinya. Housemates vote Savinya out (first eviction; midweek housemate-decided exit, not public vote).

timelines.title: Captaincy Crisis
timelines.message: Shathiga is targeted in Democracy Question Hour and later steps down. Vinoth assumes leadership. Muniyammal breaks down after jail/punishment.

timelines.title: Manivannan Wildcard Entry
timelines.message: Common Man finalist Manivannan Uppiliappan enters as first wildcard after Pandi's exit. He had been rejected on premiere stage.

timelines.title: Black Pandi Walks Out
timelines.message: Pandi leaves on Day 3 after a health warning. Shock exit; he had been active in kitchen and entertainment.

timelines.title: Shathiga Becomes First Captain
timelines.message: Shathiga wins the first captaincy. Vinoth becomes opposition leader. Democracy Room rules are introduced.

timelines.title: First Tasks and Leadership Battle
timelines.message: Night Stars overnight entertainment task begins. Jananayagam leadership task shortlists Jason, Muthazhagi, Shama, Shathiga and Vinoth. Early kitchen/duty clashes start, including Shathiga vs Muniyammal.

timelines.title: 19 Housemates Enter
timelines.message: Selected lineup: Lakshmi Priya, Shathiga, Prithivinath, Javeed Sherif, Muthazhagi, Asmitha Neelamegam, Avinash Ashok, Pandi (Black Pandi), Vinoth Babu, Chandini Tamilarasan, Savinya Velu, Kumaran Thangarajan, Raaghav Ranganathan, Dhanyaa Pallath, Mukesh, Adavadi Ansar, plus Common Man winners Shama, Muniyammal and Jason.

timelines.title: Live Audience Selection Twist
timelines.message: About 29–30 shortlisted faces pitch live. Studio audience vote immediately. Roughly 10–11 are rejected on stage before entry. First time commoners compete with celebrities.

timelines.title: Season 10 Grand Premiere
timelines.message: Bigg Boss Tamil 10 (Carnivizha) launches on Star Vijay and JioHotstar with host Vijay Sethupathi. Theme is a 10-year carnival. House features a gender-neutral bedroom, captain bedroom, Common Man mural, central courtyard dining table, and a new Democracy Room for leader vs opposition.
